# Starling UI Demo

> Interactive demo app for the cdx-solidjs-components (Starling UI) component library. Built with SolidJS, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS.

## Quick Start

```bash
cd apps/cdx-solidjs-components
vp install
vp dev            # starts demo at http://localhost:5173
```

## Key Files

- [App.tsx](src/App.tsx): Main demo app with sidebar navigation, command palette, and section routing
- [index.html](index.html): HTML entry with inline theme persistence script
- [style.css](src/style.css): Demo-specific styles, CSS variable mappings, and style presets
- [Preview](src/components/Preview.tsx): Reusable component preview wrapper (live demo + code snippet)

## Demo Sections

- [IntroSection](src/components/IntroSection.tsx): Landing / hero
- [GetStartedSection](src/components/GetStartedSection.tsx): Installation guide
- [ThemingSection](src/components/ThemingSection.tsx): Theme system overview
- [ThemeCreator](src/components/ThemeCreator.tsx): Interactive theme builder
- [LayoutSection](src/components/LayoutSection.tsx): Card, ScrollArea, AspectRatio
- [FormsSection](src/components/FormsSection.tsx): Buttons, inputs, selects, sliders, switches
- [NavSection](src/components/NavSection.tsx): Tabs, Breadcrumb, Sidebar
- [DataSection](src/components/DataSection.tsx): Badge, Table, Avatar, Kbd, Calendar
- [FeedbackSection](src/components/FeedbackSection.tsx): Alert, Progress, Skeleton, Toast
- [OverlaysSection](src/components/OverlaysSection.tsx): Modal, Sheet, Popover, Tooltip, Command
- [DisclosureSection](src/components/DisclosureSection.tsx): Accordion, Collapsible, Carousel
- [UtilsSection](src/components/UtilsSection.tsx): Hooks and directives

## Library

The component source lives under `lib/` at the workspace root. Published as `cdx-solidjs-components` on npm.
